plan: Drive: from Iskut, about 78 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 58.27242, -130.59523, pull off on Hwy 51 (Telegraph Creek Rd) (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 35 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 987 m, about 806 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 150 m NE of the spot at 1,050 m (58.5289, -130.95161). Water: unnamed wetland 120 m SW (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Aug, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-22, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-12, closures 2026-10-16.
R6P-moose-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-22: about 778 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.06 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
